title.narrative: Improving solid sanitation governance across 19 medium-sized cities in Burkina Faso

description.narrative: Improving public health in 19 local authorities due to improved governance and ownership by local authorities; the development of efficient and cost-effective waste management companies; and behavioural change among the population.OS1: The communal authorities of 19 territorial communities have strengthened their capacity to manage solid wastewater treatmentSO2: Micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) active in solid waste management are formalized and create sustainable green jobsSO3: The population adheres to the waste management system through awareness and mobilization actions
